'''Gavin Palmer''' finished 4th at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec-sun">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Sunday semi-final results], Decipher (7 December 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427191534/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Internet Archive]</ref> He won the [[1997 Tatooine Regionals (Salt Lake City)]], a qualifier for that event.<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 19 years-old and have been playing Star Wars CCG since February '96. I was born and raised in Durango. It's a small town, so I have to travel to most of the Star Wars CCG events in which I participate. I love to downhill ski; play full contact football (the only fun way to play); and play sand volleyball. I also enjoy weight training, drama, and Star Wars CCG. I attend Fort Lewis College and keep a 4.0 GPA. I work for BULA, a winter headwear company founded in Durango: BULA is one of the official sponsors of the '98 Winter Olympics. My favorite movies include the Star Wars trilogy, Braveheart and The Princess Bride. My favorite Dark Side card is There'll Be Hell to Pay. My favorite Light Side card is Grimtaash. Also, I love the Tonnika Sisters. I mean, I really love them!"<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/palmer.html Gavin Palmer], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428022253/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/palmer.html Internet Archive]</ref>
